cluster_fsid.description: Unique 128-bit UUID of the Ceph cluster (e.g., 'a0b1c2d3-e4f5-6789-abcd-ef0123456789')

mon_initial_members.description: List of hostnames/IPs of the initial monitor nodes; must match mon_host order

mon_host.description: List of monitor hostnames/IPs (must include all mon_initial_members)

auth_cluster_required.description: Authentication method required for cluster communication (e.g., 'cephx', 'none')

auth_service_required.description: Authentication method required for service daemons (e.g., 'cephx', 'none')

auth_client_required.description: Authentication method required for client connections (e.g., 'cephx', 'none')

osd_pool_default_pg_autoscale_mode.description: Enable automatic PG count scaling: 'on', 'off', or 'warn'

osd_pool_default_size.description: Default replication size for new pools (number of copies per object)

osd_pool_default_min_size.description: Minimum replication size allowed for writes in a pool

osd_pool_default_pg_num.description: Initial number of placement groups per pool (must be power of 2)

osd_pool_default_pgp_num.description: Initial number of placement group placement states (usually equals pg_num)

mgr_initial_modules.description: List of initial mgr modules to load at startup (e.g., ['balancer', 'status', 'restful'])

mgr_modules.description: List of mgr modules to enable (e.g., ['dashboard', 'prometheus', 'restful']); 'dashboard' required for web UI

enable_dashboard.description: Enable the Ceph Dashboard web UI

dashboard_server_addr.description: IP address for the dashboard web server to bind to (e.g., '0.0.0.0' or '127.0.0.1')

dashboard_server_port.description: Port for the dashboard web server (defaults to 8443 for HTTPS)

dashboard_ssl_cert_path.description: Path to the SSL certificate file for the dashboard (auto-generated if missing)

dashboard_ssl_key_path.description: Path to the SSL private key file for the dashboard

dashboard_ssl_enabled.description: Enable HTTPS for the dashboard web UI

dashboard_api_server_addr.description: IP address for the dashboard API server (backend services)

dashboard_api_server_port.description: Port for the dashboard API server (defaults to 8080 for HTTP)

dashboard_api_ssl_enabled.description: Enable HTTPS for the dashboard API server (not recommended in production without external TLS)

dashboard_api_ssl_cert_path.description: Path to the SSL certificate for the dashboard API (leave empty to use dashboard cert)

dashboard_api_ssl_key_path.description: Path to the SSL key for the dashboard API (leave empty to use dashboard key)

mgr_daemons.description: Optional list of per-host mgr daemons for fine-tuned placement or priority
